avoid_supplements.name: Calcium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Calcium binds alendronate in GI tract, significantly reducing oral bioavailability (up to 60% reduction)
avoid_supplements.action: Separate dosing by at least 30 minutes; take alendronate on empty stomach, then wait ≥30 minutes before calcium intake

avoid_supplements.name: Iron supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Divalent cations (iron) form chelate complexes with bisphosphonates, reducing absorption
avoid_supplements.action: Separate by at least 30 minutes from alendronate dosing

avoid_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Divalent cation chelation reduces alendronate bioavailability
avoid_supplements.action: Separate dosing by at least 30 minutes

avoid_supplements.name: Zinc supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Divalent cation chelation impairs alendronate GI absorption
avoid_supplements.action: Separate by minimum 30 minutes from alendronate administration

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin D supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: While beneficial for bone health, excessive vitamin D may increase hypercalcemia risk; alendronate addresses calcium homeostasis
caution_supplements.action: Monitor serum calcium and vitamin D levels; coordinate dosing with healthcare provider

avoid_foods.name: All foods and beverages (except plain water)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Food significantly reduces alendronate oral bioavailability; alendronate must be taken on empty stomach for adequate absorption
avoid_foods.action: Take with plain water only, 30 minutes before first food/beverage of day; remain upright for 30 minutes post-dose

avoid_foods.name: Dairy products (milk, cheese, yogurt)
avoid_foods.mechanism: High calcium content chelates alendronate, reducing absorption by 50-60%
avoid_foods.action: Avoid within 30 minutes before and after alendronate dose

avoid_foods.name: Fortified foods (calcium-fortified juices, cereals)
avoid_foods.action: Separate from alendronate dosing by at least 30 minutes

caution_foods.name: Calcium-rich foods (leafy greens, almonds, sardines)
caution_foods.mechanism: While part of balanced diet for bone health, high calcium meals consumed near dosing time may reduce alendronate absorption
caution_foods.action: Plan calcium-rich meals ≥30 minutes after alendronate; maintain adequate overall dietary calcium intake

monitoring_notes: Alendronate absorption is highly dependent on proper administration technique (empty stomach, upright posture, 30-minute fasting periods). Monitor for GI side effects (heartburn, esophageal irritation) and ensure adequate vitamin D and dietary calcium intake separate from dosing windows to maintain therapeutic efficacy and bone health.
